training.cost_scope: inclusive label evaluations (including unused offline-oracle metrics) and fitting
training.degenerate_states: already-admitted or emergency STOP; no resource refund; delta zero
training.deployment_scope: repeated routing differs from frozen one-step reference target
training.optimizer: normalized squared-error SGD, learning rate 0.2, coordinate bound 8
training.target: exact one-paid-MPC-then-fast minus all-fast; never optimal-oracle labels
